request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: Must the UR10e robot, as delivered by the manufacturer, bear the CE mark under the Machinery Directive?

response.text: {"kind": "boolean", "value": false, "text": "No. The UR10e is delivered as a partly completed machine with an EU Declaration of Incorporation (Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC, Annex II B), not a Declaration of Conformity; the integrator who completes the machine applies the CE mark. The Directive also says the CE marking goes on machinery (Art. 16), and partly completed machinery is covered by Art. 13 and Art. 6(2) rather than a CE conformity marking.", "sources": [{"file": "ur10e-manual.md", "place": "20. Declarations and Certifications, 20.1. Declaration of Incorporation (original), p. 227 (manual p. 230)", "quote": "Universal Robots e-Series (UR3e, UR5e, UR7e, UR10e, UR12e and UR16e) shall only be put into service upon being integrated into a final complete machine (robot application or cell), which conforms with the provisions of the Machinery Directive and other applicable Directives."}, {"file": "ur10e-manual.md", "place": "20. Declarations and Certifications, 20.1. Declaration of Incorporation (original), p. 227 (manual p. 230)", "quote": "When this partly completed machine is integrated and becomes a complete machine, the integrator is responsible for the completed machine fulfiling all applicable Directives, applying the CE mark and providing the Declaration of Conformity (DOC)."}, {"file": "DIR.md", "place": "Article 13 Procedure for partly completed machinery", "quote": "(c) a declaration of incorporation described in Annex II, part 1, Section B has been drawn up."}, {"file": "DIR.md", "place": "Article 16 CE marking", "quote": "2. The CE marking shall be affixed to the machinery visibly, legibly and indelibly in accordance with Annex III."}]}
